events.title: The Stitchline Roadblock
events.description: A barricade of knotted bobbins and taut running-stitch cord stretches across the patchwork lane while hostile figures stir behind the cloth.

choices.text: Break through the stitched barricade (Fight)
Pay the road toll (spend 14 gold)
Turn back down the quiet seam (Leave)

events.title: The Frayed Bridge Watch
events.description: A swaying bridge of braided felt spans a dark ravine, where armed sentries block the crossing until thread or steel settles the right of way.

choices.text: Hold the frayed bridge by force (Fight)
Offer two thread bundles for safe passage (spend 2 scraps)
Retreat from the bridge crossing (Leave)

events.title: The Lanternless Ambush
events.description: Guttering wicks leave a velvet hollow in deep dusk as lurking shapes close around the unlit crossroads.

choices.text: Stand and face the closing shadows (Fight)
Buy a sealed lantern pass (spend 18 gold)
Slip back to the lit road (Leave)

events.title: The Knotted-Yarn Patrol
events.description: Tangled skeins of heavy wool snare the roadside posts while a roving patrol demands a tribute of yarn to clear the path.

choices.text: Cut the snares and confront the patrol (Fight)
Trade a spare yarn scrap to pass (spend 1 scrap)
Skirt the knotted wool (Leave)

events.title: The Buttonwall Checkpoint
events.description: A rampart of stacked brass buttons and heavy quilted shields seals the narrow pass against travellers without a stamped token.

choices.text: Challenge the buttonwall garrison (Fight)
Purchase a stamped gate token (spend 20 gold)
Step away from the checkpoint (Leave)

events.title: The Bellspool Picket
events.description: A chain of oversized brass bells and thread-wrapped spools blocks the moonlit lane; doll sentries turn as one when the bells ring.

choices.text: Ring the bellspool and face the sentries (Fight)
Pay the bell toll (spend 16 gold)
Retreat along the quiet seam (Leave)

events.title: The Scissor-Clock Tollhouse
events.description: A squat button-eyed tollkeeper shelters under a giant scissor-faced clock; its brass blades tick as stitched sentries bar the midnight lane.

choices.text: Cut the scissor-clock chain and confront the sentries (Fight)
Pay 17 gold for a stamped scissor-clock pass
Take the unlit side path (Leave)

events.title: The Mothglass Lantern Patrol
events.description: A plump moth puppet circles a huge glass lantern as candle-eyed guards block the velvet road with stretched silk wings.

choices.text: Scatter the moth-wing guards and fight through (Fight)
Offer 2 scrap bundles of wick thread for passage
Follow the dark path around the lantern (Leave)

events.title: The Crowpin Quilt Checkpoint
events.description: A button-eyed crow doll perches on an oversized silver safety pin above an oxblood quilt wall; masked guards wait beneath its wings.

choices.text: Raise the crowpin banner and challenge the guards (Fight)
Pay 13 gold for a crowpin crossing token
Turn away from the quilt wall (Leave)

events.title: The Button-Drum Masquerade
events.description: A brass-button drum booms beneath plum bunting; round masked ragdoll drummers raise patched shields to block the torchlit street.

choices.text: Challenge the button-drummers at the barricade (Fight)
Trade 3 scrap bundles for a guarded pass
Slip past the quiet bunting (Leave)

events.title: The Inklace Paper-Doll Tribunal
events.description: A round inkblue paper-doll magistrate bangs an enormous silver needle gavel while button-eyed witnesses stretch a black-lace cord across the road.

choices.text: Defy the needle verdict and face the doll bailiffs (Fight)
Pay 19 gold for the magistrate's wax-sealed writ
Slip away before the next gavel stitch (Leave)

events.title: The Mossroot Button Snare
events.description: Huge moss-cloth roots knot around a fallen button tree as squat nettle-puppet wardens tighten brass clasps across the shadowed lane.

choices.text: Cut the giant button roots and confront the nettle wardens (Fight)
Give the wardens 2 scrap bundles to loosen the clasp
Take the long path around the rooted tree (Leave)

events.title: The Oxblood Wardrobe Checkpoint
events.description: A giant wheeled oxblood wardrobe rattles in the mist, its coat-sleeve puppets marching under a padlock the size of a shield.

choices.text: Force the wardrobe latch and battle the coat guards (Fight)
Spend 23 gold on the oversized brass wardrobe key
Turn away from the marching sleeves (Leave)

events.title: The Bone-Cream Mirror Masquerade
events.description: A crooked bone-cream hand mirror hangs from red stitches above a roadside masked ball; its button-eyed reflection guards bar the threadbare passage.

choices.text: Pull the mask seams and face the reflection guards (Fight)
Surrender 3 scrap bundles to repair the mirror's edge
Back away from the laughing reflections (Leave)

events.title: The Midnight Needle Ferry
events.description: A squat button-eyed ferryman plants an enormous silver needle oar across a black quilt river; three hooded doll sentries pull the ferry's oxblood rope taut.

choices.text: Seize the giant needle oar and face the ferry sentries (Fight)
Pay 18 gold for a stitched night-ferry token
Follow the dim bank instead (Leave)

events.title: The Glass-Eye Marionette Gate
events.description: A huge cloudy glass-button eye hangs over a pin-laced gate as four plump velvet marionette guards tug their stiff strings into a barricade.

choices.text: Cut the puppet strings and confront the dangling guards (Fight)
Offer 2 scrap bundles to loosen the gate's puppet strings
Back away while the glass eye stays shut (Leave)

events.title: The Briar-Hem Procession
events.description: Three round mourning dolls haul a coffin-sized brass thimble beneath a mossy briar arch; a stout bell-bearing marshal bars the candlelit lane.

choices.text: Challenge the briar-hem marshal and its mourners (Fight)
Pay 22 gold for the marshal's stitched passage seal
Let the mourning parade pass ahead (Leave)

events.title: The Ashen Wick Clocktower
events.description: A leaning quilted clocktower turns a giant unlit candle into its hour hand; squat pin-helmet dolls brace a brass pendulum across the road.

choices.text: Break the brass pendulum line and fight the clock guards (Fight)
Surrender 3 scrap bundles for the clock guards' safe passage
Wait outside the tower until the guards leave (Leave)

events.title: The Pincushion Observatory
events.description: Above the moonlit path, a colossal moss-plaid pincushion turns like an observatory dome; plump pin-helmet sentries peer through silver-needle telescopes and latch the brass stairgate.

choices.text: Scatter the needle sentries and take the stairgate (Fight)
Pay 15 gold for a brass stargazer token
Leave the telescope needles pointed at the dark

events.title: The Velvet Spool Lift
events.description: A moon-sized oxblood spool winds a hanging lift between split floorboards; three round button-eyed porters knot its black rope across the only crossing.

choices.text: Challenge the spool porters at the lift (Fight)
Offer 2 scraps to bind the lift and cross quietly
Follow the floorboard edge instead

events.title: The Silver-Ruler Viaduct
events.description: An enormous dressmaker's ruler bridges a gap in the toy road; squat bone-cream surveyor dolls brace its brass hinges with stitched measuring tapes.

choices.text: Topple the ruler barricade and face the surveyors (Fight)
Pay 21 gold for a stamped crossing measure
Wait for the ruler bridge to fold shut

events.title: The Oxblood Music-Box Checkpoint
events.description: An enormous oxblood music box straddles the floorboard lane; three plump button-eyed sentries turn its brass winding key while a toothed velvet tune gate blocks the dolls.

choices.text: Silence the winding sentries and force the music-box gate (Fight)
Pay 17 gold for a copper winding pass
Let the music box finish its crooked lullaby

events.title: The Crimson Zipper Causeway
events.description: A carriage-sized crimson zipper joins two torn felt cliffs; round burlap puller dolls brace its brass teeth with rope as a loose black thread snarls at their ankles.

choices.text: Wrench the zipper teeth apart and fight the puller dolls (Fight)
Offer 2 scraps to stitch a safe crossing
Follow the frayed cliff hem away from the zipper

events.title: The Moss-Felt Scissorbridge
events.description: Two enormous blunted dressmaking shears form a wavering bridge above a black button pond; squat moss-felt keeper dolls guard its brass pivot beneath a tiny candle lantern.

choices.text: Break the scissor lock and face the keeper dolls (Fight)
Pay 23 gold for a dull-blade crossing permit
Take the long bank around the quiet button pond

events.title: The Bone-Key Turnstile
events.description: A house-sized ring of tarnished keys turns in the seam of the corridor wall; button-eyed latchkeepers haul it by red cord while each key casts a second shadow.

choices.text: Break the spinning latch and face the keykeepers (Fight)
Bind the swinging keys with 2 scraps for safe passage
Follow the narrow wall seam away from the keys

events.title: The Ember Matchbox Roadblock
events.description: A fallen matchbox blocks the floorboard road, its charred sticks propped upright as watchtowers; soot-smudged ragdoll wardens hold a red-thread tripline across the glowing drawer.

choices.text: Cut the tripline and confront the matchbox wardens (Fight)
Pay 18 gold for an ember-safe crossing token
Take the long unlit route beside the skirting board

events.title: The Moonlit Tea-Strainer Crossing
events.description: A silver tea strainer swings over a gap between quilted floorboards, carrying a tiny bridge of black lace; three aproned doll porters keep its chain taut by candlelight.

choices.text: Seize the strainer bridge and face the porters (Fight)
Offer 3 scraps to lash the strainer safely in place
Back away from the swinging silver mesh
